name: Bugarra (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green with a narrow white stripe, charged at the upper hoist with the crowned arms of Bugarra (a deer on green and a chequy on red).
history: The flag of Bugarra is of proportions 2:3, three horizontal stripes, the upper red, the central white and the lower green, the upper and lower stripes each three sevenths of the total width and the central the remaining seventh, with the municipal arms placed next to the hoist in the upper corner; it was approved by resolution of 6 August 1996 of the Conseller of the Presidency and published in the DOGV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 10 January 1995.

features.role: Bugarra arms — deer on green and a chequy on red
